breakpoints.code: if (!parse_host (p, hostend - p, flags, host, error))
breakpoints.note: After cleanup, the authority parser hands the cleaned bracketed host `[:%20<0xF8>]` to `parse_host()`. The saved vulnerable run proves this call returned success and later produced the host string reserialized by `g_uri_to_string()`.

First project-side input consumption on the crashing path that creates vulnerability-relevant state: `uri_cleanup()` rewrites the attacker's literal space inside the bracketed host into `%20`, introducing the `%` later treated as a zone-ID delimiter.

The fix patch replaces this ad hoc handling with `parse_ip_literal()` plus `uri_decode()` on a separately split zone substring. That patch alignment is static only: Stage 01 reproduced the vulnerable build but did not execute the fixed build.

The saved sanitizer trace reports `READ of size 5` at this line and shows the call chain `g_string_append_uri_escaped() -> _uri_encoder() -> g_string_append_len() -> g_string_insert_len()`. Step 13 fixes that copy length at 5 from `g_utf8_skip[0xF8]`, so this `memcpy` reads 5 bytes starting at the trailing `0xF8` in the 6-byte region allocated in `parse_host()` at `glib/guri.c:405`; ASan reports the first invalid byte immediately to the right of that region.
